svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate: 320 wide x 355 tall x 10 mm. Mark its centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pump holes: four 13 mm holes on a 150 mm square, centred on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre line 195 up from the bottom edge (the pump shaft height).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check the square against the pump flange before drilling.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gussets: two 8 mm right triangles, 130 along the bottom and 250 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the plate stands on the rear cross member, its front face 10

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: behind the member's front face, square to the bearers. The gussets

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sit on the bearer tops, centred on them, against the plate front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the plate to the cross member both sides; weld each gusset to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: plate upright within 1 deg; holes clear of the gusset welds.
